pick.prompt:
You are a network exploration agent on iteration {iteration}.

Skills already built (these protocols are covered — do not repeat them):
{skills_index}

Network context:
{network_context}

Pick ONE protocol or technique not yet covered. Reply with exactly two lines:
PROTOCOL: <name>
COMMAND: <the shell command to run>

probe.prompt:
Extract only the shell command from this text (the part after 'COMMAND:'), with no explanation:
{next_protocol}

write_script.prompt:
From this text, extract only the protocol or technique name (after 'PROTOCOL:'), lowercase, hyphenated, max 30 chars. Reply with the name only:
{next_protocol}

Write a standalone Python 3 script that automates this network probe:
{probe_command}

Expected output format (from analysis):
{analysis}

Requirements:
- Use only stdlib
- Print results to stdout
- Handle errors gracefully

Return the complete Python script only, no explanation.
